newsitem.title: USA: Louis Dreyfus to buy Am Exploration.
newsitem.headline: Louis Dreyfus to buy Am Exploration.

text.p: Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas Corp is to buy American Exploration Co for $350 million in a deal which will create an independent oil and gas company worth $1.0-$1.2 billion, the companies said in a statement.
Under the terms of the deal, American shareholders will receive 0.72 shares of Dreyfus common stock and $3.00 in cash.
American shares closed up 1/4 at 14-3/4 and Dreyfus off 1/8 at 17-7/8 before the deal was announced.
The combined companies had reserves of one trillion cubic feet of natural gas and 33 million barrels of oil and daily production of 249 million cubic feet of natural gas and 9,100 barrels of oil.
